answers.goal: I want to continue making art for musicians and working in creative direction, along with my experiences in putting together live music events. This is all in an effort to one day open an independent live music venue back home in San Francisco, dedicated to the history and culture of the city, creating a central community space for artists to be discovered and heard.
answers.drew: I have always loved music art, new and old. i’ve found myself obsessed with music and art history and how it informs what is created in our modern world. Growing up in San Francisco, in the Haight Ashbury at the center of the Summer of Love hippie movement has deeply inspired my expansive way of thinking about music and art, and influenced what I create. I love that my creativity can collaborate and build upon an artists music, creating a visual representation of their work through my album/single covers, concert posters, lyric videos, set design, etc.
answers.seeking: I want to meet other creatives who inspire me, and can potentially be collaborators to work with because I love finding new friends and people who push me to grow more in making art!
answers.inspiration: A huge central inspiration for me are the artists who created the Filmore flyers for the concerts in the 60s in San Francisco, coining the distinct 60s psychedelic style we think of from that time.
